paragraphs.text: ወበካልእ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ አኀዙ፡ ርኩሳን፡ መናፍስት፡ ያስሕትዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወይትዐርጉ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወያስሕትዎሙ፡

i18n.en: And in the second week of this jubilee the unclean spirits began to lead astray the grandchildren of Noah, and to come up against them, and to lead them astray.

paragraphs.commentary: The foundational demonological etiology: the dead giants' spirits afflict humanity. Bidirectional to 1 En 15:8-12 + Jub 5:7-9 (the giants slaughter each other before the Flood).

paragraphs.text: ወመጽኡ፡ ኀበ፡ ኖኅ፡ አቡሆሙ፡ ወዜነውዎ፡ በእንተ፡ መናፍስት፡ እለ፡ ያስሕትዎሙ፡ ወያዕውርዎሙ፡ ወይቀትልዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ደቂቆሙ፡

i18n.en: And they came to Noah their father, and told him concerning the spirits who were leading astray and blinding and killing their grandchildren.

paragraphs.text: ወጸለየ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላኩ፡ ወይቤ፡ አምላከ፡ መናፍስት፡ እለ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ዘገበርከ፡ ሊተ፡ ምሕረተ፡ ወዘአድኀንከ፡ ኪያየ፡ ወለደቂቅየ፡ እምነ፡ ማይ፡ አይኅ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ መውዓ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኬዱ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለመናፍስት፡ እኩያን፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቅነ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ይትኰነኑ፡ መናፍስት፡ ዘሕያው፡ ወዘርእስ፡ ወዘረሰዩ፡ ለሕይወት

i18n.en: And he prayed before the Lord his God, and said: God of the spirits in all flesh, who has shown mercy unto me, and has saved me and my sons from the waters of the flood, and has not let me perish as you did the sons of perdition — for great is your grace upon me, and great is your mercy upon my soul — let your grace be lifted up over my sons; and let not the wicked spirits rule over them, lest they destroy them from the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወአንተ፡ ባርክ፡ ኪያየ፡ ወደቂቅየ፡ ከመ፡ ንብዛኅ፡ ወንምልእ፡ ምድረ፡ ወባርክ፡ ዘርእነ፡ ለትኩን፡ ይትደምሩ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ዘወሀብከ፡ ሊተ፡ ወለደቂቅየ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትገሐሡ፡ እምነ፡ ጻድቅ፡ እምነ፡ ይእዜ፡ ወእስከ፡ ለዓለም፡

i18n.en: But you, bless me and my sons, that we may multiply and fill the earth; and bless our seed, that they may join themselves to the holy spirit which you have given to me and to my sons, that they may not turn aside from righteousness from now on and unto eternity.

paragraphs.text: ወአንተ፡ ኣአምር፡ ዘገብሩ፡ ላዕለ፡ መዋዕልየ፡ ወእለ፡ መናፍስት፡ ሕያው፡ ሐንበሊ፡ ኬሊዎሙ፡ ወቦጥ፡ መሐሎሙ፡ ወአስርሙ፡ ለመካን፡ ኩናኔ፡ ወኢይትገበር፡ ሙስና፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ግብርከ፡ አምላኪየ፡ እስመ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ መነንከ፡ ወአስተአተትከ፡ ለርእስከ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡

i18n.en: And you know what your Watchers did in my days, and as for these spirits — the living ones — shut them up and hold them fast in the place of judgment, and let them not bring destruction upon the children of your servant, my God; for these are malevolent, and they have been created to corrupt mankind upon the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወይእዜኒ፡ መናፍስት፡ ዘሕያው፡ እምነ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ ለኄሊያን፡ እሙንቱ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወወድቁ፡ ብእሲሁ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ እምነ፡ መካናቲሆሙ፡ ወያስሕትዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወአስተአተተ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለመካናት፡ ኵናኔ፡

i18n.en: And now the spirits which proceed from the flesh of the giants — these are the ones upon whom judgment must be done. They have come forth, each man and his wife, from their places; and they lead astray the sons of men, and they have removed them to the places of judgment.

paragraphs.text: ወአዘዘ፡ እግዚእ፡ መላእክተ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቅብዎሙ፡ ለመናፍስት፡ ኩኖ፡ ይኩኑ፡ ይትዐለዉ፡ መካናተ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ለመናፍስት፡ ኩናኔ፡ ኄሊያን፡

i18n.en: And the Lord commanded the angels of judgment to bind the spirits — that they should be confined in the places of judgment, the spirits of judgment of the giants.

paragraphs.text: ወመጽአ፡ መልአከ፡ መናፍስት፡ መስቴማ፡ ወይቤ፡ እግዚእነ፡ ፈጣሪ፡ ኅድጎሙ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ቅድሜየ፡ ወይሰምዑ፡ ቃልየ፡ ወይግበሩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘእብል፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ እስመ፡ እመ፡ ኢተሐድጉ፡ ሊተ፡ ሕላፍ፡ ስልጣን፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኢይክል፡ ገቢረ፡ ሥልጣን፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ እስመ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለስሕተተ፡ ወለመሕየቅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ኩናኔየ፡ እስመ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ዐመፃሆሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡

i18n.en: And Mastema, the chief of the spirits, came and said: Lord, Creator, leave some of them before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them — for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will upon the sons of men. For these are appointed for corruption and for leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.

paragraphs.commentary: MASTEMA INTRODUCED. The prince-of-the-spirits petitions God to leave 1/10 of the demons unbound — the bargain establishing the limited-evil framework. One of the earliest extant proper-noun designations of the Satan-figure.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤ፡ ዘዘ፡ ዐሥሮሙ፡ የሐድጉ፡ ቦቱ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ወዘዘ፡ ተስዐሙ፡ ያውርዱ፡ ውስተ፡ መካን፡ ኩናኔ፡

i18n.en: And he said: Let a tenth part of them remain before him, but let nine parts descend into the place of judgment.

paragraphs.text: ወአዘዘ፡ አሐደ፡ እምነ፡ መላእክተ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ከመ፡ ይማህሮ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፈውሰ፡ እስመ፡ ያአምር፡ ከመ፡ ኢይሕወሩ፡ በቅዱስ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ለፈውስ፡ በከመ፡ ኖኅ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ዘይምሕር፡

i18n.en: And he commanded one of the holy angels to teach Noah every remedy — for he knew that they did not walk in the upright way, and that not in every righteousness would they conduct themselves — so that Noah, who was righteous and merciful, might administer healing for them.

paragraphs.commentary: Noah's medicinal book: the angel of the presence teaches Noah pharmacological knowledge against the remaining demons. Foundational text for the Sefer Refuot tradition.

paragraphs.text: ወአዘዝነ፡ ኖኅ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፈውሰ፡ በጥቡዕ፡ ለዕፀው፡ ምድር፡ በከመ፡ መሐርነ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ለፈውስ፡ ኵሉ፡ መድኀኒተ፡ መናፍስት፡ እኩያን

i18n.en: And we taught Noah every remedy in accordance with the manner of the trees of the earth — even as we had taught him for healing — every remedy against the evil spirits.

paragraphs.text: ወጸሐፍዎ፡ ኖኅ፡ ኵሎ፡ በውስተ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ በከመ፡ መሐርናሁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግዕዘ፡ ፈውስ፡ ወአሰረ፡ መናፍስት፡ እኩያን፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡

i18n.en: And Noah wrote everything down in a book according as we had taught him concerning every kind of healing; and thus the evil spirits were restrained from following the sons of Noah.

paragraphs.text: ወወሀቦ፡ ለሴም፡ ወልዱ፡ ኄረ፡ ኵሎ፡ መጻሕፍተ፡ ዘጸሐፈ፡ እስመ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ያፈቅር፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ደቂቁ፡

i18n.en: And he gave all the books that he had written to Shem his eldest son; for he loved him more than all his sons.

paragraphs.text: ወመጻሕፍት፡ ዘሄኖክ፡ ወዘኖኅ፡ ዕቁባት፡ ቦቱ፡ ለሴም፡

i18n.en: And the books of Enoch and the books of Noah were entrusted to Shem.

paragraphs.text: ወበ፪ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ለ፪ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ሞተ፡ ኖኅ፡ ፱፻፶ ዓመት፡ ኮኖ፡ በሕይወቱ፡ ፲ ኢዮቤልዋተ፡ ወ፪ ሰሙን፡ ወ፭ ዓመተ፡

i18n.en: And in the third week of the second jubilee Noah died; nine hundred and fifty years he had lived — ten jubilees and two weeks and five years.

paragraphs.text: ወአልቦ፡ ዘመዋዕለ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ዓመት፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለሐሬሁ፡ መንበሩ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይነብር፡ በምድር፡ ኪያሁ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወመንፈሰ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ቦቱ፡ ሰብእ፡

i18n.en: And he surpassed in his days the years of every man who dwelt upon the earth, in righteousness — a man in whom was the holy spirit.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ካልእ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘይነበር፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ዘይኬዕው፡ ለሎቱ፡ ለቤት፡ ለትውልዱ፡ ኖኅ፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሄኖክ፡ እመ፡ ኢተወሀበ፡ ለሎቱ፡ ዘ፰ መዋዕለ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ምስለ፡ ቤቱ፡ ለትውልዱ፡ ለነፈል፡ ምድር፡

i18n.en: For from the days of Enoch there was none among the sons of men like Noah — none whose years and the years of his household reached so far for the building up of the earth — except that there was given to him the days of the eight jubilees together with his house, for the generations to fill the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወበ፴ ወ፫ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ነሥእዎ፡ ለፋሌቅ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ሎሙና፡ ወለተ፡ ሲነዐር፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሬዑ፡ ወይቤ፡ ናሁ፡ እኩይ፡ ኮኑ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ በምክር፡ እኩይ፡ ለሐነጽ፡ ርእሰ፡ ሎሙ፡ ሀገረ፡ ወማኅፈደ፡ በምድር፡ ሺንዐር፡

i18n.en: And in the first year of the first week of the thirty-third jubilee Peleg took for himself a wife whose name was Lomna, the daughter of Sinaar; and she bore him a son in the fourth year of this week, and he called his name Reu — for he said: Behold, the sons of men have become evil through their evil purpose to build for themselves a city and a tower in the land of Shinar.

paragraphs.text: ወወፅኡ፡ እምነ፡ ምድረ፡ አራራት፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ኀበ፡ ሺንዐር፡ እስመ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ሎሙ፡ ሐነጹ፡ ሀገረ፡ ወማኅፈደ፡ ወይቤሉ፡ ንዕርግ፡ ቦቱ፡ ሰማየ፡

i18n.en: For they went forth from the land of Ararat toward the east, unto Shinar; and in their days they built the city and the tower, saying: Let us ascend by it into heaven.

paragraphs.text: ወአኀዙ፡ ይኅንጹ፡ ወበራብዕ፡ ሰሙን፡ አዕተቡ፡ በእሳት፡ ዘመባልሕት፡ ለነዲቅ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወለቅርጻን፡ ኮኖሙ፡ ጥንቃቀ፡ ሰፈት፡ እንተ፡ ይነጽሕ፡ እምነ፡ ባሕር፡ ወእምነ፡ ማየ፡ ማእምቃተ፡ ዘሺንዐር፡

i18n.en: And they began to build; and in the fourth week they hardened with fire the bricks for building, and the bitumen served them for mortar — the bitumen that came up from the sea and from the springs of waters in the land of Shinar.

paragraphs.text: ወሐነጹ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ፵ ወ፫ ዓመተ፡ ኮኑ፡ የሐንጹ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ስፍሐቱ፡ ፪ ምእት፡ ወ፴ ብእድ፡ ወቆሙ፡ ሰፈርዎ፡ ቍጻይዎ፡ ካዕበ፡ ለርእስ፡ ዓሥር፡ መንበር፡ ጥቅም፡ መንበሮ፡

i18n.en: And they built it for forty-three years; its breadth was two hundred and thirty courses of brick, and its height was as the height of one course of brick — at the top — multiplied tenfold.

paragraphs.commentary: The wind-overthrow of the Tower — a Jubilees-distinctive elaboration of Gen 11. Cross-corpus to Pseudo-Philo Bib. Ant. 7:5 + Sib. Or. 3:97-109 + 3 Bar 3 + b. Sanhedrin 109a.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላክነ፡ ናሁ፡ ሕዝብ፡ አሐዱ፡ ወልሳን፡ አሐዱ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ ወዝንቱ፡ አኀዙ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይክሎሙ፡ ናሁ፡ ንረድ፡ ወንባልኆሙ፡ ልሳኖሙ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይስምዑ፡ አሐዱ፡ ቃለ፡ ካልኡ፡ ወይዘረዉ፡ ውስተ፡ መካናት፡ ወውስተ፡ ሕዘባት፡ ወኢይትባአስ፡ ለሎሙ፡ ካዕበ፡ ምክር፡ አሐዱ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ኩናኔ፡

i18n.en: And the Lord our God said: Behold, they are one people, and one language is to them all; and this they have begun to do, and now nothing will be withheld from them. Behold, let us descend and confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech; and they shall be scattered into the regions and among the nations, and they shall not again take counsel together until the day of judgment.

paragraphs.text: ወወረደ፡ እግዚእ፡ ወወረድነ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ለነፂር፡ ሀገረ፡ ወማኅፈደ፡ ዘሐነጹ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡

i18n.en: And the Lord descended, and we descended with him, to see the city and the tower which the sons of men had built.

paragraphs.text: ወባልኆ፡ ኵሎ፡ ቃላተ፡ ልሳኖሙ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘሰምዐ፡ አሐዱ፡ ቃለ፡ ካልኡ፡ ወአስተአተቱ፡ እምነ፡ ነዲቆ፡ ሀገር፡ ወማኅፈድ፡

i18n.en: And he confounded all the words of their tongue, and no one understood the speech of his fellow; and they ceased from building the city and the tower.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተሰምየ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘሺንዐር፡ ባቤል፡ እስመ፡ ህየ፡ ባልኀ፡ እግዚእ፡ ኵሉ፡ ልሳነ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወእምህየ፡ ዘረውዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሀገሮሙ፡ በከመ፡ ልሳኖሙ፡ ወመነበሪሆሙ፡

i18n.en: On account of this all the land of Shinar was called Babel — because there the Lord confounded all the language of the sons of men; and from there they were scattered into all their cities, each according to his tongue and his dwelling-place.

paragraphs.text: ወአፍተተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ነፋሰ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ላዕለ፡ ማኅፈድ፡ ወአውድቆ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወናሁ፡ ሀለወ፡ ማእከለ፡ አሱር፡ ወባቤል፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ሺንዐር፡ ወሰመይዎ፡ ስሞ፡ ምሥቃት፡

i18n.en: And the Lord sent forth a great wind against the tower, and overthrew it upon the earth; and behold, it lies between Asshur and Babel in the land of Shinar, and they called its name the Overthrow.

paragraphs.text: ወበ፴ ወ፬ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ቅሉጥ፡ ኮኑ፡ መንገለ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ሐበሰ፡ ምድር፡ ዘሐም፡ ወድኅረዝ፡ ካዕበ፡ መንገለ፡ መካን፡ ዘዕፆሙ፡ ወረከበ፡ ከንዓን፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ መንገለ፡ ግብጽ፡ ሠናየ፡ ጥቀ፡ ወኢሖረ፡ ውስተ፡ ዕፁ፡ ምድር፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ባሕር፡ አላ፡ ኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡

i18n.en: And in the first week of the thirty-fourth jubilee they were scattered toward Lebanon and toward the borders of the land of Ham; and after this they returned each to his own place. And Canaan saw the land of Lebanon as far as Egypt — that it was very good — and he did not go into the land of his portion, toward the western sea; but he settled in the land of Lebanon, on the east and on the west.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤልዎ፡ ሐም፡ ወካን፡ ወያፌት፡ አኀዊሁ፡ በውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ዘአኮ፡ መክፈልትከ፡ ኀደርከ፡ እመነ፡ ዕፅከ፡ አኮ፡ ወፅአ፡ ይከውን፡ እምነ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኢተግበር፡ ከመዝ፡ ወእመ፡ ገበርከ፡ አንተ፡ ወውሉድከ፡ ትወድቅ፡ ውስተ፡ መካን፡ ዘዘ፡ በምድረ፡ ወረጉማነ፡ ላዕለ፡ መርገም፡ ትከውን፡

i18n.en: And Ham his father, and Cush and Mizraim his brothers, said to him: You have settled in a land that is not yours, and which did not come out as your lot. Do not do so; for if you do so, you and your sons will fall in the land and be accursed by a curse — for you have settled by sedition, and your sons shall fall by sedition.

paragraphs.text: ወኢሰምዐ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ እምነ፡ ሐማት፡ እስከ፡ መግቢአ፡ ግብጽ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ እስከ፡ ዮም፡

i18n.en: But he did not hearken to them; and he dwelt in the land of Lebanon — from Hamath as far as the entrance of Egypt — he and his sons until this day.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተሰምየት፡ ምድር፡ ይእቲ፡ ዘከንዓን፡

i18n.en: On account of this that land is called the land of Canaan.

paragraphs.text: ወያፌትሰ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ዘመረ፡ መንገለ፡ ባሕር፡ ወኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ዕፁ፡ ወረከበ፡ ማዳይ፡ ምድረ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለባሕር፡ ወአስተአተተ፡ ቆደቆዶ፡ ይእቲ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ወኢሰምዕዎ፡ አኀዊሁ፡ ለሎቱ፡ ወይቤልዎ፡ ኢተግባእ፡ ዕፆሙ፡

i18n.en: And Japheth and his sons went toward the sea, and dwelt in the land of his portion. And Madai saw the land beside the sea, but it did not please him — for the land of his portion was toward the north; and his brothers would not heed him when he said: I will not enter their lot.

paragraphs.text: ወኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ዘሴም፡ ወሐርየ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ሴም፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ኀደር፡ ዕፅከ፡ ግፍ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ወአፍቅረከ፡ ግፍ፡ ላዕሌየ፡

i18n.en: And he dwelt in the land of Shem; and Shem accepted him, and said to him: Dwell in your portion beside me — and I love you exceedingly.

paragraphs.text: ወአቀመ፡ ሎቱ፡ ምድረ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ሐርያ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ወሰመይዎ፡ ለመንግሥቱ፡ ማዳይ፡ ለርእስ፡ አበዊሁ፡ እስከ፡ ዮም፡

i18n.en: And he established a land of his kingdom for him; and his sons inherited his kingdom after him, and they called his kingdom Madai, after the name of their father, until this day.

paragraphs.text: ወአልቦ፡ ካልአ፡ ምንተኒ፡ ምን፡ ሰማዕነ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ መንግሥቶሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ እምነ፡ ዕለታት፡ ኖኅ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለታት፡ አብርሃም፡

i18n.en: And nothing else have we heard concerning the kingdoms of the sons of Noah upon the earth, from the days of Noah unto the days of Abraham.
